name: typst-korean
description: Korean reports with verified sources, reusable Typst layouts, tables, captions, and local PDF checks. Honor explicit submission formats.

interface.shortDescription: Korean reports, tables, and PDF validation
interface.longDescription: Default report workflow for Juhyeok when no output format is specified. Uses available Korean fonts, source-aware writing, optional cover and contents, multipage tables, and local compilation. Explicit formats and organizer requirements take precedence.
defaultPrompt: Create a Korean report with verified facts and an available Korean font, then compile and check the PDF.
